privacy.title: Data privacy
privacy.desc: Each data purpose has separate controls. Data access remains owner-authorized.
privacy.readOnlyNote: Consent records are recorded from your latest agreements and displayed as read-only.
privacy.exportDesc: Download your birth profiles, purchased reports, and account data as a JSON file.
privacy.deleteDesc: Request deletion of your account, saved charts, and reports. Details below.
privacy.deleteConfirm: You are requesting deletion of your account and all data. This action is irreversible once the recovery window expires.
privacy.deleteAck: I understand financial transaction records are preserved separately under statutory accounting obligations.
privacy.deletionPendingBanner: Account deletion is requested (recovery deadline: {date}). You may cancel this request at any time before the deadline.
privacy.sharedLinksDesc: Shared chart links. Personal birth details are hidden by default.
privacy.sharedLinksEmpty: You haven't shared any links yet.
privacy.deleteRecoveryDesc: Your account enters a 30-day recovery window during which you can sign in and cancel the deletion request before lifecycle data is permanently purged.
privacy.deletePurgeDesc: Birth profiles, revisions, calculated charts, and account-linked reports will be permanently purged after the recovery window expires.
privacy.deleteRetainedDesc: Order invoices and payment transaction records are preserved separately for statutory accounting compliance as required by law, detached from purged birth profiles.
